question: Does a fixed observation-constrained route heuristic improve complete-game fractional winner credit versus the established collector heuristic under both declared opposing rosters and two legal scenario families, without changing authoritative rules?

design.development_use: Correctness checks only; no recorded outcome-based candidate tuning
design.training: None; independently authored deterministic heuristic, not learned model
design.assignment: Focal seat0..3; three cyclic rotations of ordered opposing roster across remaining ascending seats; pair baseline/candidate under identical seed/rules/opponents. Duplicate policy names yield duplicate full assignments; retain as declared balanced technical repeats, not independent trials.
design.unit: One complete multiplayer game; aggregation family is scenario+seed+roster across12assignments and paired arms
design.holdout_boundary: Heldout roster and seeds excluded from correctness/development execution; one frozen candidate evaluation. Configuration visible to implementation/evaluator agents; procedural separation, not enforced blinding or sandbox. Policies cannot observe declared opponent names or source seed.
design.seed_confound: Seed jointly changes starting positions, initiative and event sequence. Policy rotation does not identify pure initiative effect.
design.forecast: Current/next published forecast permitted; not illicit information.

endpoints.primary: Per focal seat fractional credit1/k for membership in nonempty authoritative terminal winner set of size k, otherwise0. Mean paired candidate-minus-baseline, averaged equally over assignments/seeds/scenarios within each roster.
endpoints.incomplete: Never invent terminal outcome or zero-credit loss; record incomplete separately and invalidate comparative acceptance if any technical interruption
endpoints.accounting: Credits sum1 for every complete nonempty winner set; membership can sum above1. No universal25%target.

analysis.acceptance: Correctness controls and all complete games required. Finite-suite robust improvement only if each roster mean delta>=0.05 and every scenario-by-roster mean delta>=0. No claim of universal superiority. Otherwise retain negative/mixed/inconclusive result without retuning.
analysis.uncertainty: Finite explicitly enumerated deterministic suite, not probabilistic sample. Report exact family/assignment effect ranges and subgroup sensitivity; do not invent population CI or independent-seat binomial interval. No unseen-world generalization.
analysis.common_scenarios: Report observed family-level baseline/candidate covariance and variance of paired differences versus sum of arm variances; shared seeds are not assumed to improve precision.
analysis.multiplicity: One fixed candidate, one primary endpoint, two required robustness rosters; secondary results descriptive.

controls: Illegal action rejected without owner state mutation
Observation construction/source state immutable and no evaluator-only fields
Isolated Fork previews cannot commit outcomes
Conservation after each actual accepted transition
Trace replay binds exact rules/seed and reconstructs authoritative terminal result
Forged outcome or credit reporter rejected
Unsupported policy/config or action-limit interruption reported/refused

limits.stop: Abort/record nonzero on exceptions, illegal action, changed identities, missing assignments, incomplete games or wall deadline; preserve failure, no success-shaped retries. Correctness bugs may be corrected with superseded evidence and a new identified final execution.
limits.policy_budget: No recursion/training/network; bounded legal-action heuristic. Record maximum/total selection timing; whole-process1800s cap bounds stalls, not an enforced per-decision sandbox.

source_lock: Parent runner must hash authoritative Core, evaluator/candidate and this protocol before execution and verify unchanged afterwards. Freeze manifest distinct from outcome output.
transfer: No North Star AI integration claimed. Any combat/identity transfer requires separate actual consumer and acceptance; exact future beneficiary and test to be stated after results.
specialist_basis: SCI-077 negative retention, denominator and dependency discipline
